Briefing by the Department of Water Resources on the 20-year water strategy and wetland restoration
se: The meeting heard a representative of the Department of Water Resources explain the 20-year water resources management strategy under the vision "secure water, confident people", and its work restoring wetlands, as background for the study of water management in farm areas outside irrigation zones
it: The 20-year water resources management strategy and wetland restoration

te: Briefing by the Department of Local Administration on local authorities' care of water sources
se: The meeting heard a representative of the Department of Local Administration explain the management of water sources in the care of local authorities, the water source database, and the rules for spending budget on developing water sources, as background for the study on water in farm areas outside irrigation zones
it: Local authorities' management of water sources, the water source database and budget rules

The whole beef cattle problem studied with cooperatives and the farmers' council
se: The meeting noted information on the role of cooperatives in supporting cattle farmers, some of which have grown into integrated businesses, and information from the National Farmers Council on low beef cattle prices, imports, the use of beta-agonists, export limits and slaughterhouse standards. It then considered the laws that apply along the whole beef cattle production and marketing chain
it: The role of cooperatives, and the National Farmers Council's proposals on beef cattle
Laws on beef cattle production and marketing

te: Blackchin tilapia (part 5): academics describe the situation
se: The meeting invited the Faculty of Fisheries, Kasetsart University, and biology academics to give information. They felt the situation is improving, but this fish breeds fast and adapts well, and when it gets into farm ponds it eats young shrimp and fish, so farmers and the public should be taught how to remove it

te: Blackchin tilapia (part 4): the Department of Fisheries, the Department of Livestock Development and fishmeal producers give information
se: The meeting invited the Department of Fisheries, the Department of Livestock Development and a representative of fishmeal producers to give information on tackling blackchin tilapia, such as the fish's origin and features, its spread abroad and in Thailand, and ways to use the fish

te: Draft royal decree to renew licences by paying a fee studied
se: The meeting made an advance study of the draft Royal Decree Requiring Licensees to Pay a Licence Renewal Fee instead of Applying for Renewal (proposed by the Council of Ministers), for the 6 laws relevant to the committee, such as the laws on fertilisers, groundwater, animal feed and hazardous substances. Committee members are to study it and give observations at the next meeting. The meeting also noted the progress of the subcommittees
it: Draft Royal Decree Requiring Licensees to Pay a Licence Renewal Fee instead of Applying for Renewal

te: Beef cattle marketing strategy studied, and a water study visit to Nakhon Pathom prepared
se: The meeting considered issues for the study of beef cattle marketing strategy and products, such as the state's role in opening markets, export and halal standards, and raising meat shops to standard. It considered the schedule of the water management study visit to Nakhon Pathom Province on 11 December 2025, and petitions, such as a proposal to amend the Cooperatives Act and the Chumphon Provincial Farmers Council's proposal to solve durian problems across the whole system
it: Study of beef cattle marketing strategy and product development
Schedule of the water management study visit, Nakhon Pathom Province
A proposal to amend the Cooperatives Act, and a proposal to solve durian problems

te: Blackchin tilapia (part 3): the Department of Agricultural Extension and the Department of Agriculture give information
se: The meeting invited the Department of Agricultural Extension and the Department of Agriculture to give information on working with farmer institutions and community enterprises to process blackchin tilapia, such as into fermented fish (pla ra), which has met obstacles because the fish has little flesh and many bones
